description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It provides mechanisms for validating values against expected ranges, regex, or custom functions, and managing multiple validators.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for representing and validating expected values, ranges, or regex patterns for a type T.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class for validating a value of type T using expected values or custom functions.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value against the expected criteria (discrete set, range, regex).

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the ValidationManager by name, either from ExpectedValues or a custom function.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a custom logging function for validation messages.
